title: Long Vowel Patterns
introduction: Read familiar words with long vowel spelling patterns.
definition: Read familiar words with long vowel spelling patterns.
rules: Letter groups can represent a single vowel sound.
Practise ai, ay, ee, oa and silent-e words.

examples.question: Complete: r__n (ai or ee), water falling from clouds.
steps: The ai pattern represents the long a sound in rain.

examples.question: Complete: d__ (ay or oa), a period of daylight.
steps: The ay pattern represents long a at the end of day.

exercises.question: Complete: r__n (ai or ee), water falling from clouds.
exercises.solution: The ai pattern represents the long a sound in rain.

exercises.question: Complete: d__ (ay or oa), a period of daylight.
exercises.solution: The ay pattern represents long a at the end of day.

exercises.question: Complete: f__t (ee or ai), plural of foot.
exercises.solution: The ee pattern represents the long ee sound.

exercises.question: Complete: b__t (oa or ee), a vehicle on water.
exercises.solution: The oa pattern represents the long o sound.

exercises.question: Which has the same vowel sound as cake: lake or cat?
exercises.solution: Silent e helps mark the long a sound in both words.

exercises.question: Which rhymes with kite: night or kit?
exercises.solution: Kite and night share the long i sound and final t.

summary: Read familiar words with long vowel spelling patterns. Letter groups can represent a single vowel sound.
